typography.heading_strategy: Use Spectral for authoritative, calm, and reflective headings. Apply tracking-tight for larger sizes.
typography.body_strategy: Use Figtree for clean, highly readable, non-partisan body copy and UI elements.

colors.notes: Absolutely NO red-vs-blue partisan styling. Rely on warm creams, moss greens, and soft clays to create a civic, calm, and nonpartisan environment.

layout_spacing.strategy: Generous spacing philosophy (p-8 to p-12 for containers) to enforce a 'slow down and reflect' mindset. Use the Control Room grid for the two-column Needs Identification and bento patterns for Collaborative Solutions.

components.buttons: Rounded-full or softly rounded-lg. Primary buttons use the moss green (#4A5D4E) with white text. Hover states lift slightly (-translate-y-0.5) with a soft shadow.
components.inputs: Shadcn components heavily customized: soft rounded boxes with #FFFFFF backgrounds and #E8E3D9 borders. No harsh black borders.
components.cards: Flat solid surfaces. No glassmorphism (can feel too techy). Subtle 1px border (#E8E3D9) and shadow-sm.
components.wizard_progress: A discrete, text-based or dotted progress indicator at the top (e.g., 'Step 2 of 6: Position Mapping').
components.needs_chips: Small pill-shaped tags. Editable. Background: #F5F2EA, Text: #2D2A26. Close/Edit icon on hover.
components.solution_cards: Bento-style layout inside. Clear sections for 'Needs Met (A)', 'Needs Met (B)', and 'Unmet'.

motion_interactions.page_transitions: Framer Motion: Fade in and slide up slightly (initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}, animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}).
motion_interactions.hover_states: Soft scaling (scale-105 for chips) and background color shifts.
motion_interactions.loading: Gentle pulsing of abstract shapes or a slow fade-in, not a generic spinner.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA/WCAG compliance. Charcoal text (#2D2A26) on cream background provides excellent contrast. Primary button (#4A5D4E) with white text is highly readable.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case based on role (e.g., data-testid='start-issue-button', data-testid='need-chip-edit').

media.rules: Use images to set a calm, grounded mood. Do not use standard tech/corporate illustrations.

images.description: Abstract design with smooth curves and warm earthy shades, creating a calm artistic appeal.
Serene forest path with sunlight, indicating finding a path forward.
Diverse group collaborating at a round table, representing integrative solutions.

page_specific_instructions.Landing: Large typography. Hero uses the calm abstract background (low opacity, bg-[#FDFBF7]/90 overlay). Centered, spacious. CTA: 'Start a New Issue'.
page_specific_instructions.Issue_Input: Clean form. Suggest preloaded examples as soft chips below the input field.
page_specific_instructions.Position_Mapping: Two distinct areas (Your Position vs Opposing Position). Neutral, non-judgmental language.
page_specific_instructions.Needs_Identification: Two columns side-by-side. Translate positions into underlying needs using editable chips.
page_specific_instructions.Collaborative_Solutions: Display 3-5 generated solutions. Detailed card showing what needs from A & B are met.
page_specific_instructions.Reflection: A quiet, text-focused form. Ask 'Did this change your understanding?'.
page_specific_instructions.Save_Export: Dashboard view. Simple cards for saved issue maps. Actions: Export as PDF, Copy Markdown.

iconography: lucide-react for standard UI icons. Keep stroke width thin (1.5) for a refined look.
